# PokeRule

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Validation` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/Validation/Rules/GripRules.cs#L716)

Checks the poke surfaces in the open scene, and that there is a hand able to touch them.

Every finding here leaves the surface looking finished and doing nothing. A trigger is
invisible to the finger probes, a collider named on a surface it does not belong to is never
found, and a scene whose hands carry no pushout has fingers that go through everything - and
in all three cases nothing throws and nothing is logged.
